card.name: Repeated word after 'and' or 'to'
card.fires_on: A word that repeats the word just before it, usually after 'and' or 'to' (shout, shout; grew and grew; doctor to doctor). Also fires on a repeated symbol or number.

modes.label: Repeated word
modes.description: The same word is said twice in a row, often joined by 'and' or 'to', for emphasis.
modes.example: Over the years it grew and<< grew>>.

modes.label: Repeated symbol or name
modes.description: A symbol, number or name is doubled in a table or name.

card.plain: It lights up when a word is repeated right after itself, like 'on and on' or 'doctor to doctor'.
